explanation: His men dragged warships overland on greased logs into the Golden Horn, bypassing a great chain across the harbour. He made the city his capital.

claims.text: Sultan Mehmed II captured Constantinople on 29 May 1453.
Mehmed II was 21 years old when he took Constantinople.
Suleiman the Magnificent and Selim I ruled in the 1500s, and Osman I founded the Ottoman dynasty around 1300.
During the siege, Ottoman forces moved ships overland on greased logs into the Golden Horn to get past the chain across its mouth.
Mehmed II made Constantinople the Ottoman capital.
